title: Turfbarge, a towhorse with pendent head, a bargeman
html_source: Charleville Mall runs parallel with the Royal Canal, so the barge, tow horse, and bargeman make sense. The photo is of the canal one hundred yards or so northwest of the Newcomen Bridge on Strand Road where Father Conmee would have crossed the canal.
